## 1. XUE 2025 DISSERTATION — verdict: PARTIAL-OVERLAP (vs Claim 1a "conformal per-TMB-stratum prediction intervals for signature exposures")

Record identity:
- OpenAlex W7126542226, type = "dissertation", publication_date 2025-01-01, author Catherine Xue, no DOI, cited_by_count 0. [M]
- Full abstract RECOVERED via OpenAlex abstract_inverted_index (4,632 chars) — recorded as [M] (indexed metadata served by API, not the DASH page text).

Abstract content [M]:
- Ch. 2: BayesPowerNMF — Bayesian NMF with power posteriors for robustness to misspecification; full Bayesian inference gives uncertainty for BOTH signatures and loadings; applied to ICGC/TCGA PCAWG WGS.
- Ch. 3: maximum-density method for Dirichlet parameter specification (general stats; used for priors/simulations in signature work).
- Ch. 4: UQ for NNLS (loadings-only, per-sample signature activity) via exactly TWO routes: (1) NNLS↔OLS equivalency confidence intervals for non-zero loadings; (2) bootstrap — resample the observed mutation counts vector, re-run NNLS per replicate, build bootstrap CIs. Reports "well-calibrated confidence intervals for loadings estimates" in simulations.

Determination points:
(i) Conformal prediction? NO [M] — the abstract names Bayesian power posteriors, OLS-equivalency CIs, and bootstrap CIs; the word conformal never appears (in the indexed abstract).
(ii) Application to signature EXPOSURES (per-sample activities)? YES [M] — Ch. 2 loadings UQ + Ch. 4 NNLS loadings-only inference, explicitly "activity of a fixed set of signatures in a single tumor genome".
(iii) Per-stratum (per-TMB-stratum) calibration? NO [M] — no stratification of any kind is mentioned; calibration claim is global ("well-calibrated confidence intervals"), simulation-based.
(iv) Dissertation, not peer-reviewed paper? YES [M] (OpenAlex type=dissertation; DASH-only). NOTE [M]: Ch. 2 material is published as Xue, Miller, Carter, Huggins, "Robust discovery of mutational signatures using power posteriors", PLoS Comput Biol 2026, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014372, PMC13274926 (Semantic Scholar search hit) — so part of the dissertation IS now peer-reviewed.

Access routes log:
- curl https://dash.harvard.edu/handle/1/42725950 (browser UA) → HTTP 429, 1515-byte "Web Firewall · 429" stub [P] (reproduces the previously recorded blocking behavior).
- OpenAlex /works/W7126542226 → 200, full record + abstract_inverted_index [M].
- Semantic Scholar title search → surfaced the PLoS Comp Biol 2026 paper (Ch. 2) [M]; dissertation itself not in S2 results returned.
- PDF/bitstream discovery: OpenAlex records no pdf_url at any location [M]; DASH blocked before HTML could be parsed for bitstream link.

Verdict: PARTIAL-OVERLAP. Evidence: (1) [M] Xue 2025 is a dissertation on UQ for NMF/NNLS in exactly the mutational-signature-exposures domain — same problem space as Claim 1(a), so the domain is NOT empty. (2) [M] Its UQ machinery is Bayesian posterior / OLS-equivalency CI / bootstrap — not conformal prediction — and no per-TMB-stratum or any covariate-stratified calibration appears. (3) [M] cited_by_count 0; no peer-reviewed per-stratum conformal-interval method surfaced. Caveat: verdict rests on the indexed abstract only (full text inaccessible: DASH 429 ×1 this session + 3 prior failures on record); a conformal chapter cannot be ruled out from full-text, but chapters are enumerated in the abstract and none is conformal.
